name: Arcadys Regiones de Chile
author: rarcemunoz

sections.description:
Arcadys Regiones de Chile adds the regions and communes of Chile to the WooCommerce checkout and lets you set shipping rates by commune. The interface is in Spanish (Chile), ready to be translated at translate.wordpress.org.

This plugin is the continuation of “MkRapel Regiones y Ciudades de Chile para WC” (slug wc-ciudades-y-regiones-de-chile), which the same author released in 2020 under the Marketing Rapel name. Its last version was 4.3.0 (17.12.2021). Version 5.0.0 is a full rewrite under the Arcadys name; shipping methods and their communes are migrated automatically (see “Upgrading from MkRapel”).

Author: Arcadys (Rodrigo Arce Muñoz). Support: soporte@arcadys.cl

  • The 16 regions of Chile, from Arica y Parinacota to Magallanes, with the names WooCommerce uses.
  • The 346 communes, with corrected names (La Calera, Quintero, Buin, Panguipulli, Curaco de Vélez, Hualaihué, Cholchol, San Pedro de la Paz, Aysén, Cabo de Hornos, Natales and others).
  • Classic checkout and My account: the “Comuna” field becomes a searchable list of the communes of the selected region.
  • Commune validation: an order or address with a commune that does not belong to the region is rejected. Common old spellings are accepted and corrected (for example “Puerto Aysén” becomes “Aysén”).
  • Postcode hidden for Chile (optional).
  • “Envío por comuna” shipping method for shipping zones: choose communes, a cost (with WooCommerce formulas, [qty], [cost], [fee] and [free minimo="…" valor="…"]), tax status, shipping class costs and “single method” (hides the other rates when it applies).
  • Optional RUT field (off, optional or required) with check digit validation (módulo 11) and 12.345.678-9 format. It is saved in the order and the customer account and shown in the admin, emails and order details. Works in classic and block checkout.
  • Compatible with HPOS (custom order tables) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.

Settings are in WooCommerce › Ajustes › General › “Regiones y comunas de Chile”.

Upgrading from MkRapel

  1. Deactivate and delete “MkRapel Regiones y Ciudades de Chile para WC” (deleting it does not remove orders or shipping zones).
  2. Install and activate Arcadys Regiones de Chile.
  3. Open any admin page once. The “Envío por Ciudad CL” methods of your shipping zones become “Envío por comuna”, with the same communes (misspelled names are corrected), costs and options.

The old checkout field editor is not included. WooCommerce now has its own way to add checkout fields; the old settings (wc_fields_billing, wc_fields_shipping, wc_fields_additional) are left in the database untouched, in case another plugin uses them. If you used the old RUT field, enable “Campo RUT”; old orders keep showing the RUT they saved.

Consulta anticipada de entrega

Product-page delivery estimate using Arcadys territory rates. Enabled by default for all visitors; an explicitly saved disabled setting is respected. Configure under WooCommerce > Consulta de entrega, including an optional 50/50 session comparison. Arcadys support links are available in this admin screen. Supports simple products, selected variations and quantities. The destination is kept in the WooCommerce session; final cart and checkout shipping is recalculated. Spain requires a postcode. Includes an admin simulator and aggregate pilot counters. No delivery dates or external carrier quotations. See guia-consulta-entrega.md for scope and measurement limitations.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the arcadys-regiones-de-chile folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin from Plugins › Add New.
  3. Activate it.
  4. Review WooCommerce › Ajustes › General › “Regiones y comunas de Chile”.
  5. To charge by commune: WooCommerce › Ajustes › Envío, open or create a zone with Chilean regions and add the “Envío por comuna” method.
sections.faq:
Does it include all the communes of Chile?

Yes, the 346 communes grouped by region. Developers can change the list with the arcadys_rcl_comunas filter.

Can the same commune have different prices?

Yes. Add several “Envío por comuna” methods to the zone, each with its own communes and cost. The customer sees every method that includes their commune, unless one of them uses “single method”.

Does it work on multisite?

Yes. Activate it on each site that has WooCommerce. When it is deleted from the network, its settings are removed from every site.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. Regions, commune validation, shipping by commune and the RUT field work in the block checkout. There too the city field becomes a list of the communes of the selected region. The RUT field appears when the billing or the shipping address is in Chile.

How do I offer free shipping above an amount?

In the cost of “Envío por comuna”, use [free minimo="50000" valor="3990"]: shipping is free when the cart reaches 50,000 and costs 3,990 otherwise. The amount is compared with the cart total the customer sees (with tax when prices are shown with tax). You may write amounts with your store’s thousands separator (for example 50.000), and quotes copied from a word processor (“ ”) are accepted.

Is the RUT required?

Only if you choose “Obligatorio” in “Campo RUT”. It is off by default.
sections.changelog:
5.2.4

  • Translations are now loaded from translate.wordpress.org; bundled translation files removed.

5.2.3

  • Integrate locality search into its selector, respect postcode visibility and simplify delivery labels.

5.2.2

  • Use country-specific locality labels and customer-facing shipping wording.

5.2.1

  • Enable delivery consultation by default and add Arcadys contact information in its admin screen.

5.2.0

  • Add optional early delivery consultation pilot, session-based comparison, admin simulator and counters.

5.1.0

  • Shared territory tools: reusable destination groups, exclusions, validated JSON settings and shipping transfer, catalog provenance, diagnostics, setup guide and locality search in both checkouts.
  • Tools: WooCommerce > Arcadys Territorios. Existing settings and shipping IDs are preserved.

5.0.1

  • Corrección: las fórmulas inválidas no ofrecen envío gratuito; validación antes de guardar.
  • Corrección: inicialización y accesibilidad de los selectores del checkout por bloques.
  • Compatibilidad: WooCommerce 9.9 o superior.
  • Destinos de envío identificados por territorio. Las selecciones antiguas se convierten en memoria y se guardan al actualizar el método; las coincidencias múltiples muestran un aviso.

5.0.0

  • New name: Arcadys Regiones de Chile (formerly MkRapel Regiones y Ciudades de Chile para WC), new slug and text domain arcadys-regiones-de-chile.
  • Rewritten for WordPress 6.5, PHP 8.0 and WooCommerce 8.9 or later; compatible with HPOS and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Updated list of regions and communes with corrected names.
  • Searchable commune list and commune validation by region, with correction of old spellings.
  • “Envío por comuna” replaces “Envío por Ciudad CL”; existing methods are migrated automatically. Fixed [free] and shipping class costs.
  • Optional RUT field with check digit validation, also in block checkout.
  • Removed the checkout field editor.
  • Settings moved to WooCommerce › Ajustes › General.
  • English and Brazilian Portuguese translations included.
  • Licence changed to GPLv2 or later.

4.3.0 – 17.12.2021

  • Updated region and commune abbreviations. Compatibility with WooCommerce 6.0.

4.2.0 – 15.02.2021

  • Compatibility with Chilexpress, Starken and Shipit. Minimum amount for free shipping. Fixed a commune name.

4.1.0 – 17.12.2020

  • Fixed a file include.

4.0.0 – 28.11.2020

  • Checkout field editor for billing and shipping. Plugin menu in WooCommerce.

3.0.0 to 3.5.0 – 2020

  • Compatibility fixes with WooCommerce and shipping zones in checkout.

2.0.0 to 2.2.0 – 2020

  • First version: regions and communes of Chile for WooCommerce.
